# Share Trading For Living

> Share Trading For Living (STFL) is an Indian stock-market research, investment education and analytical-tools platform.

Website: https://sharetradingforliving.com

## About STFL

STFL helps investors study Indian stocks, market activity, company fundamentals, technical indicators, IPOs, mutual funds, ETFs, unlisted shares and other investment categories.

STFL provides research and educational information. It does not guarantee investment returns or replace advice from a qualified financial professional.

## Main Research Areas

- Indian stock-market research
- NSE and BSE company research
- Fundamental analysis
- Technical analysis and interactive charts
- Market intelligence
- Top gainers, losers and active stocks
- FII and DII activity
- India VIX and market sentiment
- IPO research
- Mutual fund research
- ETF and debt-investment research
- Unlisted-share research
- Corporate actions
- Market news and sentiment
- AI-assisted investment insights
- Market astrology research
- Investment education

## Data and Research Notes

Market information may be live, delayed or based on the latest available trading session depending on the exchange, instrument and data provider.

AI-assisted insights organize available market, financial and technical information into structured observations. They should not be treated as guaranteed predictions or personalized investment advice.

Users should independently verify information, conduct their own research and consult a qualified financial professional where appropriate.
